title: A2LC: Active and Automated Label Correction for Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Cascaded manual plus automatic label correction: few human correction queries, an automatic stage propagates each correction to similar unqueried regions, tail-class-balanced acquisition.
adaptation: Only with user consent: 100 yes/no 'is this a crack' clicks on top flagged components from ranking arms, propagate answers by component feature similarity across all cells. Without clicks reduces to ensemble ranking.
min_experiment: Arm: 100 clicks + propagation, retrain. Baseline: ensemble-ranking arm without clicks. Metric: clean-49 crack relF1@2 and IoU. Kill: < +0.01 relF1@2 over no-click arm.
evidence: R: +27.23% over prior ALC at equal budget on Cityscapes; matches prior methods with 20% of budget; PASCAL VOC also.
prior_overlap: none; conflicts with no-manual-labelling rule unless a minimal case is accepted.
